class AscendAttentionMetadataBuilder(AscendAttentionMetadataBuilderBase):
    """Build attention metadata for Ascend backend."""

    metadata_cls: type[AscendMetadata] = AscendMetadata

    def _build_backend_metadata(
        self,
        common_attn_metadata: AscendCommonAttentionMetadata,
        *,
        block_table: torch.Tensor,
        query_lens: torch.Tensor,
        seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
        num_decodes: int,
        num_prefills: int,
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        prefill_meta = self._build_prefill_metadata(...)
        decode_meta = self._build_decode_metadata(...)
        return {"prefill": prefill_meta, "decode": decode_meta}
